Theo: Quick heads-up — Hosted API is GA for streaming + function/tool calling and three curated models. Rolling out globally over the next 48h. Feature details below.
Mel: Woohoo :tada:
Arjun: Nice. Which regions first?
Theo: us-west-2 then eu-west-1 then ap-southeast-1. We'll auto-route based on customer region.
Sara (Product): Rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h. We'll watch cost + latency dashboards. If you see regressions, please @eng-sre and paste logs.
Katie (DevEx): Docs + quickstart: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/streaming-tooling-ga
Arjun: Any breaking changes for existing clients?
Theo: No breaking changes to the surface. New optional query params: `stream=true`, `tool_calling=enabled`. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-open-3b","stream":true}'
```
Mel: Will we enable by default for new tenants?
Sara (Product): Default is off. Tenants can opt in; enterprise can request opt-in via support.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: hosted-api/streaming-ga -> us-west-2 (build: 2026-03-23T09:12Z)
Theo: QA notes: watch long-tail token latency for rwd-open-3b. Autoscaling min pool increased to avoid cold starts.
Elaine (Eng-SRE): Monitoring dashboards: /dashboards/hosted/streaming-ga. Alerts set for p95 latency >800ms or errors >1%. I'll post incidents to #incidents if we cross thresholds.
Arjun: I'll update SDK changelog and add a migration note.
Mel: small ask: can we add a sample tool-calling flow to docs?
Katie (DevEx): adding sample today — ETA 15:00 PT.
Sara (Product): TL;DR: GA is live, canary started, docs + samples incoming. Please escalate anything odd to #eng-sre. :rocket:
